story.text: 한옥마을 골목 끝에는 작은 편의점 하나가 있었다. 오후의 더위를 피해 나는 그 안으로 뛰어들었다.
story.reading: han-ok-ma-eul gol-mok kkeut-e-neun jak-eun pyeon-ui-jeom ha-na-ga iss-eot-da. o-hu-ui deo-wi-reul pi-hae na-neun geu an-eu-ro ttwi-eo-deul-eot-da.
story.en: At the end of the alley in Hanok Village, there was a small convenience store. Escaping the afternoon heat, I ducked inside.

story.text: 하늘도 뒤따라 들어오더니 냉장고 쪽으로 곧장 걸어갔다. '뭐 마실래, 골라.'
story.reading: ha-neul-do dwi-tta-ra deul-eo-o-deo-ni naeng-jang-go jjok-eu-ro got-jang geol-eo-gat-da. 'mwo ma-sil-lae, gol-la.'
story.en: Haneul followed in behind me and walked straight to the fridge. "What do you want to drink? Pick something."

story.text: '저기 할인 코너 있어. 1+1이야.' 그가 턱짓으로 진열대를 가리켰다.
story.reading: 'jeo-gi hal-in ko-neo iss-eo. il peul-leo-seu il-i-ya.' geu-ga teok-jit-eu-ro jin-yeol-dae-reul ga-ri-kyeot-da.
story.en: "There's a discount corner over there. It's a one-plus-one." He pointed his chin at the display shelf.

story.text: 삼각김밥을 집어 들자 하늘이 낚아채듯 확인했다. '이거 유통기한 오늘까지잖아.' 그러곤 다른 걸 집어 건넸다.
story.reading: sam-gak-gim-bap-eul jib-eo deul-ja ha-neul-i nak-a-chae-deut hwag-in-haet-da. 'i-geo yu-tong-gi-han o-neul-kka-ji-jan-a.' geu-reo-gon da-reun geol jib-eo geon-ne-ss-da.
story.en: The moment I picked up a triangle kimbap, Haneul snatched it away to check. "This expires today, you know." Then he grabbed a different one and handed it to me.

story.text: 계산대 앞에서 지갑을 꺼내려 하자, 하늘이 먼저 카드를 내밀었다. '계산은 내가 할게.'
story.reading: gye-san-dae ap-eseo ji-gab-eul kkae-nae-ryeo ha-ja, ha-neul-i meon-jeo ka-deu-reul nae-mil-eot-da. 'gye-san-eun nae-ga hal-ge.'
story.en: As I reached for my wallet at the register, Haneul already had his card out. "I'll pay."

story.text: '봉투 필요하세요?' 점원이 물었다. 내가 답하기도 전에 하늘이 먼저 고개를 저었다. '아니요, 손에 들고 갈게요.'
story.reading: 'bong-tu pil-yo-ha-se-yo?' jeom-won-i mul-eot-da. nae-ga dap-ha-gi-jeon-e ha-neul-i meon-jeo go-gae-reul jeo-eoss-da. 'a-ni-yo, son-e deul-go gal-ge-yo.'
story.en: "Do you need a bag?" the clerk asked. Before I could answer, Haneul shook his head first. "No, we'll just carry it."

story.text: 편의점을 나서며 그가 아이스크림 하나를 내 손에 쥐여줬다. 별거 아니라는 듯한 표정으로. 그냥, 평범한 오후였다.
story.reading: pyeon-ui-jeom-eul na-seo-myeo geu-ga a-i-seu-keu-rim ha-na-reul nae son-e jwi-yeo-jwot-da. byeol-geo a-ni-ra-neun deut-han pyo-jeong-eu-ro. geu-nyang, pyeong-beom-han o-hu-i-eot-da.
story.en: Walking out of the convenience store, he slipped an ice cream into my hand, wearing a face that said it was nothing. Just an ordinary afternoon.

words.example_en: There's a convenience store near here.
Please be sure to check the expiration date.
This is on sale right now.

sentences.en: Until when is the expiration date?
